### OBL-028 — Roster and enrolment data exchange

| Field              | Value                                                                              |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Source             | 1EdTech Consortium (SRC-038)                                                       |
| Authority type     | standard                                                                           |
| Citation           | OneRoster v1.2                                                                     |
| Locator            | https://www.1edtech.org/standards/oneroster                                        |
| Source version     | 1.2                                                                                |
| Verified on        | 2026-08-19                                                                         |
| Jurisdiction       | NOT-JURISDICTIONAL                                                                 |
| Applicability      | APPLIES-AT-PILOT                                                                   |
| Trigger            | A district needs to sync students, organisations, classes or enrolments into SSLS. |
| Control family     | INTEROPERABILITY                                                                   |
| Control status     | SPECIFICATION-ONLY                                                                 |
| Evidence status    | NOT-PRODUCED                                                                       |
| Owning route       | First ingestion work package                                                       |
| Review requirement | none recorded                                                                      |
| Review trigger     | First ingestion design                                                             |

**What the source states.** 1EdTech publishes the specification and operates the certification programme.

**Obligation.** Standardises exchange of roster, course and grade data through CSV bulk and REST modes. Certification is granted only after passing the test suite.

**SSLS interpretation.** Roster shape should constrain the shared-object student model now, so that a later adapter is a mapping rather than a migration.

**Current phase.** Not triggered. No ingestion path exists.

**Future phase.** Required in practice for any district pilot that must load a real roster.

**Required control.** Student and enrolment models compatible with OneRoster entities.

**Current control.** Shared-object model defines student-adjacent object types but no OneRoster mapping exists.

**Evidence required.** Mapping document plus certification if conformance is ever claimed. Minimum method: 1EdTech certification for any conformance statement; internal mapping evidence otherwise.

**Claim permitted.** SSLS may state that no roster integration exists.

**Claim refused.** OneRoster conformant; OneRoster certified; OneRoster compatible

**Note.** Implementing a specification informally is not certified conformance.

| Applicability      | APPLIES-AT-PILOT                                                                                           |
| Trigger            | SSLS must exchange multilingual-learner or special-education program data with a district or state system. |
| Control family     | INTEROPERABILITY                                                                                           |
| Control status     | MISSING                                                                                                    |
| Evidence status    | NOT-PRODUCED                                                                                               |
| Owning route       | First program data-model work package                                                                      |
| Review requirement | none recorded                                                                                              |
| Review trigger     | First program data model                                                                                   |

**What the source states.** The Ed-Fi Alliance publishes the standard and its testing tools.

**Obligation.** A community-governed K-12 data model and API. Conformance is verified through community testing rather than a paid certification badge.

**SSLS interpretation.** Program participation, service delivery and eligibility concepts should be named against Ed-Fi domains at first modelling, not renamed later.

**Current phase.** Not triggered.

**Future phase.** State-level adoption makes this the primary path for program and compliance reporting data.

**Required control.** Domain naming aligned to Ed-Fi program and student domains.

**Current control.** No program data model exists.

**Evidence required.** Mapping document plus community conformance testing if claimed. Minimum method: Community conformance testing for any conformance statement.

**Claim permitted.** None available.

**Claim refused.** Ed-Fi conformant; Ed-Fi certified

**Note.** Named MISSING rather than NOT-APPLICABLE because the product concept depends on this data class.

**What the source states.** 1EdTech publishes each specification and operates certification programmes.

**Obligation.** Specification family covering tool launch and grade passback, assessment item exchange, analytics events, competency frameworks and content packaging.

**SSLS interpretation.** Recorded as deferred so that later scope conversations start from a written position rather than an open field.

**Current phase.** Reference only. None of these capabilities exists or is planned in the current phase.

**Future phase.** LTI Advantage and Caliper become relevant on LMS embedding or analytics emission. QTI, CASE and Common Cartridge remain out of scope for a governed learner-record product.

**Required control.** None at present.

**Evidence required.** None. Minimum method: Not applicable.

**Claim permitted.** None available.
